(pg 94-115) Junk — raw scrap. Spent as a crafting and repair material by the Vault-Tec Item Blueprint Encyclopedia, which calls for it in 175 of its material cells across 168 blueprint(s), among them Scrap Metal, Steel, Power Armor Chassis, T-45.
Named outside the Crafting chapter too: reattaching a robot's severed limb costs "3 steel and 1 circuitry junk" (pg 11).
The book prints no junk table, no price and no Carry Load for any junk material, so cost and load are 0 here rather than invented — set both at your table. Quantity is the size of the stack, and crafting, repair, first aid and robot maintenance consume it by quantity.
